reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Customer Support – Unacceptable Service
reviews.text:
I have been trying to resolve an issue with my Getcontact account for over two and a half months, and I have received no meaningful response or solution despite contacting support multiple times and leaving feedback.

I am a paying Premium subscriber, yet I am still unable to add tags to my account, and nobody has bothered to properly investigate or explain the restriction. This level of customer service is completely unacceptable.

What is the point of paying for a Premium subscription if an important feature is unavailable and the support team simply ignores repeated requests for help?

I am extremely disappointed with Getcontact’s lack of communication, accountability, and respect for its paying customers. If this issue continues to be ignored, I will reconsider my subscription, leave a very negative review describing my experience, and escalate my complaint through the appropriate channels.

I am not asking for special treatment. I am asking for a proper investigation, a clear explanation, and a fair resolution after more than two and a half months of being ignored.

I hope someone finally takes this complaint seriously.

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Support and No Help at All
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing customer support and assistance.
I’ve been trying to get help with a verification issue for more than 10 days / almost two weeks, and my problem is still completely unresolved.
I provided screenshots and even a screen recording clearly showing the verification issue, yet there was no real attention or proper assistance from the support team. I followed up multiple times and even submitted the issue again, but I’m still being completely ignored with no meaningful response or solution.
It’s frustrating to see a service completely disregard a customer who has provided all the necessary information to explain the problem.
The app itself may be useful, but the customer support experience has been extremely poor. I expected at least a proper response or an attempt to resolve the issue, but after almost two weeks, I’m still waiting.
Very disappointing experience with Getcontact Support.

reviews.title: Paid User — App Freezes Every Time & I Want My Money Back
reviews.text:
I purchased the premium subscription expecting a smooth, reliable experience — but unfortunately, the app freezes completely every time I open it, making it entirely unusable. I’m a paying customer and I can’t even get past the loading screen without the app locking up.
This is incredibly frustrating. I’m paying for a service I simply cannot use. The core functionality is inaccessible due to this persistent freeze/crash issue, and there seems to be no fix on the app’s end.
For a paid subscription, this level of performance is completely unacceptable. I have not been able to benefit from this app for even a single day since purchasing the premium plan. I am formally requesting a full refund for my subscription. If the development team is unable to fix this critical bug, the least they can do is honor refund requests for affected paying users.
I strongly advise others not to purchase premium until this freezing issue is resolved.

reviews.title: Paid account with login problem
reviews.text:
I’m extremely frustrated with this app. I paid for a full year subscription, yet I can’t actually use it. Every time I log in, the app immediately logs me out and asks me to log in again — making it completely unusable.

I’ve tried everything from switching networks, using a VPN, and even deleting and reinstalling the app multiple times, but nothing works. The issue persists with no improvement at all.

What’s even more disappointing is that I’ve contacted support several times via email and received no response. This level of service is unacceptable, especially for a paid subscription.

Please fix this issue urgently or provide proper support. Right now, I’ve paid for a service I cannot use.
